title: Hincapie and Zubimendi injured in post-match training session
summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta expressed frustration after defenders Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi were injured in a post-match training session. The injuries represent a setback to Arsenal's defensive depth during a critical period of the season.
content: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says it is "far from ideal" that Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi were injured in a post-match training session.

zh.title: 辛卡皮和祖比门迪在赛后训练中受伤
zh.summary: 阿森纳主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔对后卫皮埃罗·辛卡皮和马丁·祖比门迪在赛后训练中受伤感到失望。这些伤病对阿森纳在赛季关键时期的防线深度造成了打击。

title: Silences end and boos ring out - Leicester and Martin's Savage day
summary: Leicester City suffered a defeat to Peterborough United in a match marked by vocal fan disapproval as the struggling club continues to face mounting pressure. The loss compounds Leicester's difficulties while giving Robbie Savage's Peterborough a significant victory.
content: Silences were ended and boos were heard on another tough day for Leicester City as they were beaten by Robbie Savage's Peterborough United.

zh.title: 沉默结束，嘘声响起 - 莱斯特城和马丁的艰难一天
zh.summary: 莱斯特城在一场充满球迷反对声浪的比赛中不敌彼得堡联队。随着这支陷入困境的俱乐部继续面临越来越大的压力，这次失败加剧了莱斯特城的困境，同时为罗比·萨维奇率领的彼得堡赢得了重大胜利。

title: Police officer hurt after Liverpool-Man City game
summary: A Liverpool-Manchester City clash at Anfield resulted in ten arrests and one police officer being injured amid heightened tensions between rival supporters. The incident underscores ongoing safety concerns surrounding high-profile matches.
content: Ten people were arrested amid a heightened atmosphere when the rival teams met at Anfield on Sunday.

zh.title: 利物浦对曼城比赛后警察受伤
zh.summary: 利物浦与曼城在安菲尔德球场的对阵中造成十人被捕、一名警察受伤，对手球迷之间的紧张局势升级。该事件强调了围绕高水平比赛的持续安全问题。

title: Gateshead expect players to be paid on Tuesday
summary: Gateshead FC players and staff are expected to receive overdue wages from September following the club's imminent takeover, resolving a payment crisis. The wage delays had highlighted the financial turmoil facing the club.
content: With the club on the verge of a takeover, Gateshead expect overdue wages for players and staff from September to finally be paid by Tuesday.

zh.title: 盖茨黑德预计周二支付球员薪酬
zh.summary: 盖茨黑德足球俱乐部的球员和员工预计将在该俱乐部即将被收购后收到9月份拖欠的薪酬，从而解决薪酬危机。薪酬延迟凸显了该俱乐部面临的财务困境。

title: Elite schedule 'not sustainable' amid 55-game seasons
summary: Premier League players face an unsustainable schedule with some competing in 55-game seasons, raising significant concerns about player welfare and injury risk. The heavy fixture congestion has become a contentious issue despite recent breaks in competition.
content: The Premier League may have just returned from a three-week break, but for many of its stars there was no rest at all.

zh.title: 精英赛程在55场比赛赛季中"不可持续"
zh.summary: 英超球员面临不可持续的赛程安排，部分球员需参加55场比赛，这引发了对球员福利和伤病风险的重大担忧。尽管竞争中有短暂休息，但繁重的赛事拥挤已成为一个争议性问题。

title: Peterborough deny making illegal approach for Savage
summary: Peterborough owner Darragh MacAnthony denied allegations from Forest Green's Dale Vince that the club made an improper approach for manager Robbie Savage. The dispute reflects tensions in football's managerial recruitment market.
content: Darragh MacAnthony denies claims by Forest Green owner Dale Vince that Peterborough made an illegal approach for manager Robbie Savage.

zh.title: 彼得伯勒否认对萨维奇进行非法接触
zh.summary: 彼得伯勒老板达拉·麦克安瑟尼否认了来自森林绿队的戴尔·文斯的指控，即该俱乐部对经理罗比·萨维奇进行了不适当的接触。这一纠纷反映了足球教练招聘市场中的紧张局势。

title: Women's billion-dollar boom leaves players behind, says Fifpro
summary: Women's football is projected to become a billion-dollar industry, yet a Fifpro survey reveals many players remain underpaid on insecure contracts while experiencing rising psychological stress. The findings highlight persistent inequalities despite sport's rapid commercialization.
content: Women's football is on course to become a billion-dollar industry, but many professional players are still earning low wages, working on insecure contracts and experiencing rising psychological stress, a Fifpro survey indicates.

zh.title: 女足十亿美元热潮：球员依然被冷落，Fifpro表示
zh.summary: 女子足球预计成为十亿美元产业，但Fifpro调查显示许多球员薪酬不足、合同不稳定，心理压力上升。尽管该运动商业化迅速发展，但这些发现突显了持久的不平等现象。

title: How do Women's World Cup hopes look for home nations?
summary: England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and the Republic of Ireland are competing in Women's World Cup qualifying play-offs with varying prospects for advancement. The outcomes will significantly impact each nation's representation in the next World Cup.
content: England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Scotland and the Republic of Ireland are under way in their Women's World Cup play-offs. How are their prospects looking?

zh.title: 主队国家在女足世界杯中的希望如何?
zh.summary: 英格兰、威尔士、北爱尔兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰共和国正在竞争女足世界杯资格赛附加赛，晋级前景参差不齐。这些结果将显著影响各国在下一届世界杯中的代表权。

title: Seedorf back in football as Corinthians head coach
summary: Brazilian club Corinthians appointed Clarence Seedorf as head coach, marking the former Netherlands midfielder's return to management after seven years. The appointment represents a significant strategic shift for the club.
content: Brazilian club Corinthians appoint Clarence Seedorf as their head coach, with the former Netherlands midfielder taking on his first coaching role since 2019.

zh.title: 塞多夫重返足球界担任科林蒂安斯主教练
zh.summary: 巴西俱乐部科林蒂安斯任命克拉伦斯·塞多夫为主教练，这是这位前荷兰中场球员七年后重返管理层。该任命代表了该俱乐部的重大战略转变。

title: Can Robinson solve Aberdeen's lack of goals?
summary: Aberdeen manager Stephen Robinson remains confident his team can solve their scoring problems despite another home goalless draw against St Johnstone. The team's recurring inability to finish chances has become a persistent issue affecting their season.
content: Aberdeen draw a blank again in Sunday's home loss to St Johnstone, but manager Stephen Robinson is sure his team can find a solution.

zh.title: 罗宾逊能解决阿伯丁的进球问题吗？
zh.summary: 尽管在主场与圣约翰斯通队再次战成0-0平手，阿伯丁主帅斯蒂芬·罗宾逊仍然充满信心，认为球队能够解决进球问题。球队反复无法抓住机会已成为影响赛季的持久问题。

content: All the weekend goals from the Scottish Championship, League One and League Two.

title: The 'Kane-esque' striker Spurs may regret letting go
summary: Will Lankshear has quickly impressed at Middlesbrough with his positioning and finishing after leaving Tottenham, raising questions about the club's decision to let him go. His early success suggests he could have filled an important role at his former club.
content: Will Lankshear's positioning, finishing and poacher's instinct have made him an instant hit at Riverside Stadium – and a cause of lament at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
